summary.text: Nine Spiritual Transformations is Nine Spiritual Fairy's transformation path immortal killer move. After activation it can be used only nine times in a Gu Immortal's life.

claims.text: Against Qing Chou, Nine Spiritual Fairy decides she can only use that move and activates immortal killer move Nine Spiritual Transformations. Her body shakes as she returns to human form, her aura surges beyond her prior transformed state, and nine spiritual lights shoot from her immortal aperture to form an enormous nine-colored barrier of light in nine distinct layers. By then the killer move is already completed and has no flaws. The nine layers mix into a dazzling light sphere that becomes a multi-colored rhinoceros with a large head and small body; Qing Chou collides with it and takes a small step back while the rhino only stops in place. Qing Chou finds the translucent rhino stronger than her earlier solid transformations, and Red Heart Traveler calls nine spiritual transformations a legendary transformation path killer move. After a Gu Immortal cultivates it, they can use it only nine times in their life, and Nine Spiritual Fairy expends one of those uses on Qing Chou. The light sphere later changes into a southern fire sparrow that flies up, cries, and crashes onto Qing Chou’s back so blazing flames engulf it.
